_doc: The Discover catalogs of the v2 family (Marco, 22/10/2026: countries & regions, decades & eras, and the lists by subject; reorganized by proposal 5 on 28/10/2026, see `decided`). The order of `options` is the menu's. A calculated option has exactly one of `where` (lib/moods.js, on the film's own TMDB record), `country` (the country of the card: index column `country`, else the first of `countries`), `decade` (index `decade`), `lists` (a union of 2 or more lists, no recommendation rule: an editorial collection), `any` (in one of its lists OR has one of its keywords OR has its genre: lists first, then keywords, then the rest), `runtime` ({min}, minutes), `rating` ({imdbMin, lbMin, imdbTop, tmdbVotesMin}, every condition at once) or `era` (since 15/11/2026: the id of an era file, data/eras/<id>.json, lib/era-lists.js: a school belongs by a sourced list of films, whatever the film's country, OR by a listed director's film made in the country of the movement, in the years, minus written exclusions; a cycle by the list alone; a film outside the years enters only by a written exception; the eras that are only a period keep `where`); a list option is `{ list }` and its label is the list's `short` unless it says a `label` of its own. `{ directors: { "<X loves>": { lists } } }` (once in the file) makes one card per director of the night, in the order of the build: the films of his "X loves" and of those lists; the key is the exact label the build gives the director (test/discover-catalogs.test.js compares them with data/directors-loved.json). Every list of config.json is cited exactly once, in an option, a union, an `any`, a card, or in `menuless` (lists outside the menus, still found by search and on the film page); lib/discover-catalogs.js refuses a build otherwise. `explore.genre` names the catalog whose options are the Genre filter of Explore. The menus are frozen: a change here changes the manifest and needs the addon reinstalled. `source` is for the reader of the file, the build ignores it (it names the page that defines the movement, not the list of directors, which is editorial: see `decided`, 14/11/2026). The countries are the ones with 20 or more films that he has not seen and that recommend, counted on the offline build of 22/10/2026 (Greece has exactly 20: the build warns with ! when a country of this list falls under the floor, and keeps it).
decided: Marco, 22/10/2026 (questionnaire, spec section 9): (1) a) the lists in subject catalogs, 8 new ones; Lists and Lists (unseen) leave the manifest. (2) a) each list shows what he has not seen, with the filter Include seen. (3) the rule of the country of a film is POSTPONED by him ("deixa paara dps", ~18:50 UTC, after (a) "eh o 1 mas topsy turvy eh british" and two "Segura"): the countries of this file use the rule of today, the country of the film's facts (lib/discover-catalogs.js countryOf), until he decides. (4) c) a country needs 20 films, 36 countries. (5) b) 11 regions: the 8 of the Board with Asia split into East Asia and Southeast Asia, plus Oceania and Iberia; India is a country only. (6) b) the 20 eras of the table plus the 7 optional ones, 27 eras; a music film is shown only with evidence (the rule is in the Worker for every cut, PR #74). Also decided: the TSPDT directors stay as data, no catalog of them; the five TSPDT lists (the 4 of PR #72 and the Beyond the Sight & Sound A-List) are in Critics & awards. Marco, 28/10/2026 22:38 UTC (questionnaire): releases proposal 5 (docs/2026-10-28-discover-proposta5.md of the stremio repository), and answers at ~23:0x UTC: (1) CC · Erotic Thrillers (m8t7U) goes to the Thriller genre; (2) a director's card is all the lists of the director himself plus his "loves" (the option "Todas as listas de escolhas do próprio diretor" of question 2 of the plan): Coppola = loves + Coppola recommends + Francis Ford Coppola's Closet Picks (Francis's, not Sofia's); Wenders = loves + 10 favorites + Wenders' Closet Picks; Martel, Leigh, Villeneuve, Salles and Baker = loves + their Closet Picks; Scorsese = loves + the 39 foreign films; Sofia Coppola has her "loves" alone; Voyage to Italy stays LOOSE; Megalopolis (yPRy0) goes INTO the Coppola card and the Wenders road movies (BiIyG) INTO the Wenders card (Marco, 29/10/2026 between 06:02 and 07:50 UTC (the session did not run date -u at the answer), questionnaire "Entram nos cartões": the text of the option of 28/10 had them loose, the session had put them in without him, the review of 29/10 reverted, and he then decided they enter), so the Directors drawer has 32 options (10 loose lists + the 22 cards of the night); (3) the name of a card is "X loves"; (4) the three new friends are complete friends (frente C, not this file); (5) IMDb top rated is the 250 best ratings with the ties and at least 1,000 TMDB votes (321 films on 28/10/2026). From the map he released (proposal 5, docs/2026-10-28-discover-proposta5.md): regions in his order (Latin America, Europe, Southeast Asia, East Asia, Nordic countries, British and Irish cinema, Eastern Europe and Russia, Middle East, Africa, Oceania, Iberia), countries A-Z, eras from the newest to the oldest, Genres 19 options in alphabetical order, Craft & form new, the 20 lists of `menuless` out of the menus, director-picks retired (its cards are in Directors). CHOSEN BY THE SESSION, not decided by him (reversible, a line of this file each): the term `musical` out of Dance & musicals (0 films in the column of the index); the label "Best of 21st c. (5 polls)" (29 characters became 25, the 28-character rule of 22/10/2026); the own labels of the six lists that stand alone. Marco, 14/11/2026 21:32 UTC ("ok, do the director lists then" and a questionnaire; the lists are editorial, written by the session of the specification docs/research/2026-11-14-temas-proprios-especificacao.md section 7d and cut by him, not measured data; docs/2026-11-14-eras-listas-de-diretores.md of the stremio repository has the original proposals): six eras that were country + years are now a movement by directors, like the ten before them (a film belongs if one of its directors is in the list AND it is of the years of the era; the second door of the specification, `the Wikidata says the film is of the movement`, is NOT in: the data does not exist yet). New Hollywood 1967-80 is the auteur wave only (no Spielberg, Lucas, Woody Allen, Polanski, Lumet, Forman: 45 names); Giallo 1963-83 core only (no Elio Petri, no Pupi Avati: 11); Indian Parallel Cinema 1952-89 core only, Satyajit Ray stays (no Guru Dutt: 10); Neorealism had 1943-52 with its 10 names at 21:32 UTC (the specification measured the era to 1955: not done then) and at ~22:15 UTC he chose "Extend to 1955 (recommended)": 1943-55, 24 films (Journey to Italy, Senso, The Gold of Naples and Abandoned enter); Chinese new waves is split in two, Chinese Fifth Generation (e-china-fifth-gen) and Chinese Sixth Generation (e-china-sixth-gen), and Polish cinema in two, Polish School (e-polish-school) and Cinema of Moral Anxiety (e-moral-anxiety); Postwar Britain stays a period (no kitchen-sink era). CHOSEN BY THE SESSION, not decided by him (a line each): the years of the four new eras (21:32 UTC: Fifth 1984-1999, Sixth 1990-2012, Polish School 1955-65, Moral Anxiety 1975-82; at ~22:15 UTC, after his answer, see below, WIDENED: Fifth 1984-2006, Sixth 1990- with no last year, Polish School 1955-70, Moral Anxiety 1975-89), the ids, the labels (28 characters: `Polish Moral Anxiety 1975-89` has exactly 28 (1975-82 at first), the movement is `Cinema of Moral Anxiety`) and the place of the new options in the menu (by the year each one starts, the newest first). Marco, 14/11/2026 ~22:15 UTC (questionnaire, on the report of the 21:32 branch): Giallo "Keep it by director for now (recommended)", unchanged; on China and Poland he refused the three options (widen, keep, back to one era) and wrote "find a better way, there must be more films that we can include". The session answered with three levers, all reversible: (a) wider years (above; the Moral Anxiety name is stretched past 1981: the movement of the page is 1976-81, and 1975-89 takes in Kieslowski's later Polish films and Wajda's and Zanussi's of the 1980s); (b) the films of these directors that the index does not have: data/era-filmographies.json and research/2026-11-14-era-filmographies-spec.md (the build does not read them yet; on 15/11/2026 these two moved: the films are now `school.candidates` of data/eras/*.json and the first specification is replaced by research/2026-11-14-eras-v2.md); (c) names added from the page of each movement, each with its dated source (now in `school.directors[]` of data/eras/*.json, before in data/era-filmographies.json): Fifth +6 (Huang Jianxin, Wu Ziniu, Zhang Junzhao, Hu Mei, Zhou Xiaowen, He Ping: the last by the navbox of his page only), Sixth +3 (Zhang Ming, Diao Yinan, He Jianjun), Polish School +4 (Stanislaw Rozewicz, Passendorfer, Lenartowicz, Zarzycki), Moral Anxiety +7 (Kijowski, Sass, Bajon, Zaorski, Saniewski, Andrejew, Zygadlo). Looked at and NOT added: Wang Chao (a weak source and no TMDB id on Wikidata) and Antoni Krauze (no page of the movement names him). Nobody was taken out, the doubtful names included. Marco, 14/11/2026, night (questionnaire of the eras v2, research/2026-11-14-eras-v2.md): (1) how a film enters an era of a movement: "A sourced film list, or a listed director's film made in the movement's country (recommended)": a school = the list OR the director + the country, minus written exclusions; a cycle = the list alone; a period = country + years as before; (2) China and Poland "Stay split, add the new films (recommended)"; (3) Film noir and Pre-Code "Both (recommended)": they become cycles by a list of films; (4) taking the blockbusters that enter only by the director's name out (Hero, Hard Boiled...): NOT chosen, he asked for "extensive research to define what enters each era": three researchers curate film by film and their files replace the ones of data/eras without touching code or tests of the rule; nothing was taken out on 15/11/2026; also "you can add movies to the catalogue" (the films the index does not have: slice F2, not done). Implemented on 15/11/2026 (slices F0 and F1; the index of today only): data/eras/*.json for the 17 schools and the 2 cycles, the country of the school (a table pinned by test). The written exclusions: the mechanism exists (an exclusion beats both doors) and the list STARTS EMPTY (specification 1.2(c)); it will be filled by the curation, each with a reason and a source, after he answers the question of the blockbusters (the 24 films of a listed director that the country of the school takes out today are listed in research/2026-11-15-eras-v2-antes-depois.md, with the main country that takes each out). NOT changed, because not yet asked of him: Giallo stays by director (where); New Hollywood stays the 45 authors; no new era (Screwball, Commedia all'italiana, British New Wave), no rename of Korean New Wave, the years of Moral Anxiety stay 1975-89. CHOSEN BY THE SESSION, not decided by him: the lists of films of each era are the ones the specification measured (Wikipedia lists with fixed revisions, the Criterion Channel / BFI / crew lists read on Letterboxd, the researchers' tables, the TSPDT noir list), kept as they were measured; the prefilter of the films the index does not have (IMDb 100 votes and 6.5); the countries of each school (the definition the specification measured with, `eras-v2-def-rawc2.json` of the research folder: for example CN, HK and TW for the Chinese generations, FR and CH for the Nouvelle Vague; pinned by test). Marco, 15/11/2026 (the questionnaires of the eras; his literal words are in the BACKLOG of the stremio repository and in research/2026-11-15-eras-decisoes.md): New Hollywood "only films an institution names" ("A real institution besides Wikipedia"), 1967-80 with "Six enter; E.T. and Raiders stay out" and documentaries out: it is a list now and the 45 directors no longer decide; Giallo "By the film list" with "Keep 3.5 on Letterboxd, like everything else" and Suspiria "Out of Giallo"; Pre-Code "Films a source calls Pre-Code, 1930-34"; Film noir American, British and international with "Two or more" sources, 1940-59; new eras Screwball comedy ("Yes, 1930-1950"), Commedia all'italiana ("Yes, 1958-1980, core films first") and British New Wave ("Yes, 1956-1972 as the BFI frames it, with Loach back"); Hong Kong "Both waves, 1979-2000, minus the action films" with "7 leave, the 4 on Wikipedia stay" and John Woo and Johnnie To "No: only their films that a source names"; Chinese Fifth Generation "Keep 1984-2006, take the three blockbusters out by name"; Polish School "1955-1965"; Moral Anxiety "1975-1989, named as movement and aftermath"; Fahrenheit 451 "In: a film a source names enters, whatever its country" (the list door does not look at the country). Marco, 15/11/2026 (two questionnaires, "Ask me the ones where you departed from the research"): Taiwan "Keep 1982-2000, both waves" (Tsai Ming-liang stays); Chinese Sixth Generation "1990-2018"; Iranian "Two eras: New Wave 1962-79 and Iranian art cinema 1980-" (he knocked down the session's one era 1962-2009: Iranian New Wave 1962-79 and the new Iranian art cinema 1980-, a director who crosses 1979 in both lists); Ray and Ghatak "Keep them as precursors"; Nouvelle Vague "1955-1974"; German Expressionism "Yes, create it"; the 13 noir films outside the three sections of the Wikipedia list "Keep them"; the disputed ones "Let the British ones in" (Billy Liar, A Hard Day's Night, Alfie and On the Bowery enter the British New Wave as written inclusions; the other 16 disputed films stay out). Marco, 15/11/2026 ("Only where you or a source put them"): a short enters an era only where a source names it: the director's door of an era takes no film under shortRow.minMinutes (40, isShort of lib/pool.js, the function of the Discover cuts; a film with no known runtime stays), the door of the list keeps the short that a source names (lib/discover-catalogs.js eraMember; build.js gives DC.build the number of the config). CHOSEN BY THE SESSION (authorized by Marco on 15/11/2026: 'Apply the research's recommendation in each, and show me the result'), each marked in the sheet and nothing published before he sees research/2026-11-15-eras-resultado.md: Korean cinema 1996-, Japanese New Wave 1956-74, Cinema Novo 1955-75, HK kung fu 1970-85, Neorealism with Fellini and Antonioni only by their films, Late Soviet keeps its label; Korean New Wave 1980-95 and the Soviet montage are NOT created.
